ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% low-intensity black pixels and 35% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and inner lobes are characterized by a contiguous solid black block. The left lobe exhibits a large white patch with irregular black margins and interior mottling. The right lobe is predominantly black with a localized white patch at the extreme distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; right lobe shows 7-9 distinct triangular peaks with pixel amplitudes between 8 and 20 units; left lobe edge shows similar serration but is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe trailing edges follow a broadly convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of 5-6 dark circular pixel groupings located on the white patch of the right distal tip; 3 similar circular markings detected on the mid-left white patch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent curvilinear white-on-black scar is visible in the lower right quadrant of the fluke; multiple fine-line linear disruptions are mapped across the left lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent curved white scar on the right lobe and multiple circular barnacle rosette scars on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the sharp serration frequency on the right lobe trailing edge and the specific spatial arrangement of the five dark spots on the right tip white patch.
